{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows persistent mean reversion toward lower levels, particularly with negative sentiment.",
    "Apply a mild downward bias when sentiment is consistently positive but price action shows signs of overreaction.",
    "Increase forecast conservatism in early periods of strong upward sentiment, as overconfidence often leads to overestimation.",
    "When sentiment is negative and price is trending upward, reduce forecast magnitude to avoid overcorrection.",
    "In cases of prolonged high sentiment, apply a slight downward drift to prevent runaway inflation in forecasts.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms model in early periods of a new trend, apply a lag correction by shifting forecast downward by 1-2 periods."
  ]
}
